skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain the concepts and structure of compensation, requirements of compensation systems, and the impact of compensation on other human resource management activities.
Analyze the factors influencing compensation, including external environment, organizational factors, job-related factors, and individual factors.
Apply criteria for selecting when building a compensation system.
Understand and explain the concepts related to each activity of compensation management, know how to build a compensation system, manage the salary fund, and distribute salaries to employees.
Understand and explain the concepts and roles of financial incentives, types of financial incentives, and programs for individual, team, and company-wide incentives.
Understand and explain the concepts and purposes of employee benefits, types of benefits, principles of building benefit programs, and the process of managing benefit programs.
Identify differences and relationships between compensation management activities, analyze and evaluate activities and practices of compensation management.
Discuss and propose solutions to compensation management issues in organizations.
Work effectively in groups, present and discuss group work.
Effectively communicate through writing and speaking, prepare reports and presentations.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and conduct research.
